fields.name: TimeLeft
fields.evidence: Game add-helper bg3.exe+0x18D86C0 (called from the obstruction FadeSystem update bg3.exe+0x18D7670) creates the 4-byte component with 0.5 (0x3F000000). bg3.exe+0x18D7670 (lines ~239-249) each frame does value = max(value - GameTime.DeltaTime(+8), 0) and removes the component when it reaches 0 - a countdown before the obstruction fade of view 0 stops (View1 has the same code with StopFadeTimerView1Component). Live: 0.0043..0.5 in 6 samples (dialogue, fight, helm).
